column3: Plugin manifest: version 0.2.1-rc.2, exports "." plus "./client", dsh.client.inject names remotes/locale/ui-plugin-manager as the browser half's runtime deps.
Bilingual pairing hash record for the Discover README, one hash per heading section per language, regenerated by verify-translation-pairing --write.

Package reference for the Discover tab: Host pluginMarket does the search, this package only presents it; 250 ms search debounce, 50 entries per page, Install hands the exact spec+registry to the page install dialog.
Chinese mirror of the Discover package reference with the same sections and anchors as README.md.
Discover styles; the title button covers the whole card via ::after while .cardEnd keeps the action above it, one-line description clamp, reduced-motion skeleton off switch.

598-line Discover tab UI: uncontrolled debounced search input, one-action entry cards, version list, source dialog, install confirmation, skeleton; MarketIcon remembers the failed src URL not a boolean.

Browser plugin body: registers the dictionary, the controller, three invalidation listeners (plugin-market/changed, plugin-manager/changed, connection/reset) and the discover entry in the plugins.tab slot.
84-key Discover dictionary; zh is the key-set source of truth and en is checked with satisfies Record<PluginMarketLocaleKey, string>.

DiscoverController: source reads, source edits, query and loaded pages in a snapshot store; keeps query and answered separately, guards replaced documents with fetchedAt (restart once then fail), stores a failed closure for Retry.

Pure helpers: withText flips index/relevance sort only when the text changes, declaredQuery prunes undeclared ids and returns identity when nothing changed, displayDeclarations collates with Intl.Collator.
Six-line ambient declaration that *.module.css default-exports a Record<string,string> class map.
Four-line empty Host half; the body exists only so the plugin appears in the host cordis.yml/Loader.
Registration spec over the real SlotRegistry/LocaleRuntime/TestRemote; proves Host events are ignored until the tab first renders and the slot is withdrawn on fiber disposal.
15-case UI spec: cards, install flow, filters, sorts, menus, entry page, versions, dialogs, failure states; asserts the 249/250 ms debounce boundary and models the query/answered split.

15-case controller spec: source reads/edits, pagination, document replacement, retries, disposal, invalidation; pins the exact RPC page sequences and that a dropped-id re-read publishes exactly one ready.
Six-line spec asserting the empty Host apply() does not throw.
Unit spec for the pure helpers; asserts displayDeclarations id tie-break, withText order preservation, and that declaredQuery returns the identical object.
Project references for Discover (13 packages) extending tsconfig.base.client.json with rootDir src and outDir lib/types.
Three-line bundler config calling the shared clientBundle helper with lib/types/index.js.
Plugin catalogue metadata title only (ui-reference), distinct from the runtime dictionary in src/client/locales.ts.
Chinese plugin catalogue metadata (文件与会话引用界面) with a description of the @ referencing feature.
Manifest for ui-reference; dsh.client.inject lists eight packages including ui-input-trigger and api-session-controller, and exports publishes ./locale/*.json.
Bilingual pairing hash record for the ui-reference README (18 heading sections).

Package reference for the unified @file/@session source: two verbs per directory row, sessions dated from the Host session list's updatedAt, quiet candidate-failure degradation, metadata-only session search.
Chinese mirror of the ui-reference package reference with the same five sections.
Inline file chip with a per-reference navigation-failure dialog; FolderReference deliberately ignores the injected action so a directory stays a label.

The @ reference source: parallel file/session lookups behind sessions.using with a history-open gate, rows carrying only distinguishing detail, crumbsFor refusing unwritable breadcrumb steps, two pick verbs for a directory.
16-key reference dictionary; the time.* bucket words are a deliberate namespace-local copy of the session-row vocabulary while the bucketing stays shared.
file and folder UserText matchers; the token regex requires an original whitespace boundary and strips trailing sentence punctuation only from unquoted tokens.
Nine-line empty Host half with the comment explaining the dual package/plugin convention.
706-line source spec: service declaration, session retention and history-open gating, cancellation, ordering, labels, drill breadcrumbs, pick projections, codec, preview binding.
Chip spec: opening the decoded path, non-interactive rendering, and the local retry/close dialog surviving repeated failures.
Matcher spec through the production evaluator; asserts forward-only offsets, result-object identity across Facts updates, JSON round-trippability, and punctuation handling.
Project references for ui-reference (15), including context/file-reference and context/session-reference.
Three-line bundler config calling the shared clientBundle helper.
Plugin catalogue metadata: title ui-secret-mask, description scoped to recognized keys/tokens/passwords.
Chinese plugin catalogue metadata (凭据遮挡) with the same recognized-only qualifier.
Manifest for ui-secret-mask; the smallest dsh.client.inject list in the shard (locale, ui-conversation, ui-renderer) and no scanner library dependency.
Bilingual pairing hash record for the secret-mask README (12 sections including the what-is-masked table).

Package reference: display-only masking that keeps the original text for copy and model input; recognition needs a published format; states the three limits (format-only, UserText callers only, earlier reference owns its text).
Chinese mirror of the secret-mask package reference with the same masking table and limits.
Declarative table of 29 credential formats (literal, kind, shape, run class, min/max) plus the packed ASCII character-class bit constants.
Mask builder: a shared 4096-char mark string sliced rather than repeated, line breaks preserved, BEGIN/END lines of a key block preserved, surrogate pairs counted as one mark.
Prefix-pruned linear credential scanner: literal-only alternation, sticky class runs, a flat 27-slot memo for run ends/next digit/key-block END, overlap joining, and the address-password walk-back.
Derives the scanner's lookup tables once from the format list: packed class table, per-literal tables, overlap table, ending tables, and the literal-only alternation source.
Browser plugin body registering the secretMask dictionary, the secret UserText rule and the keyed secret node renderer; masking changes only the drawn text.
Two-key secretMask dictionary for the reveal/hide control only; the masking itself is silent and untranslated.
The secret UserText rule factory: order 0 so same-start ties draw masked, reads no Facts, owns one scanner with a per-text memo.
Masked-run styles: an SVG background tile with transparent text fill so the characters stay copyable while the marks draw centred at 1ch advance, with a -0.125em optical shift.
Masked credential renderer with a per-value reveal control; holds the revealed raw value rather than a flag so a different credential re-masks.
Six-line ambient CSS-module typing, duplicated verbatim in three packages of this shard.
Nine-line empty Host half of the mask plugin.
Registration spec over the real Context/SlotRegistry/UiConversation; pins the exact inject array and that rule and renderer are released on disposal.
The backtracking regex matcher the package replaced, kept as a test-only equivalence oracle with the address-password lookbehind that defines the match semantics.
Differential test: fixed 22-string corpus plus 5000 deterministically generated strings compared to the oracle under two Facts sets, and every-offset matching.
Behavioural spec for 17 recognised formats and 6 near-miss negatives; samples assembled at run time so the repo holds no credential literal.
Renderer spec: masked display without a control, reveal/hide with Chinese accessible names, and re-masking when a different credential reuses the element.
Five project references (cordis, locale, ui-conversation, ui-renderer, ui-slots) matching the three-service inject list.
Three-line bundler config calling the shared clientBundle helper.
Plugin catalogue metadata title only (ui-skill), one of two packages whose en.json has no description.
Chinese plugin catalogue metadata (技能引用与展示) covering both the references and the call card.
Manifest for ui-skill; injects ui-tool among eight packages because the package owns a tool-call row, not just a composer affordance.
Bilingual pairing hash record for the ui-skill README (19 sections, three of them under Model Experience).

Package reference for the / skill source and skill tool row: text is the truth with host-side adjudication, the row derives from the durable call slice only, graded cache invalidation, and the append-only KV-cache statement.
Chinese mirror of the ui-skill package reference with the same five stated limitations.

Browser half of the skill plugin: session-keyed single-flight catalog cache, lexicon listeners with per-listener error containment, graded invalidation, in-flight fetch outliving a single menu interaction, and the plain-text /name pick.
Skill toolview styles with every metric as calc(24px + var(--dsh-content-font-delta)), a hover chevron cross-fade, a 260px bounded instructions card and a local visually-hidden utility.
Skill tool row derived only from the durable call slice; tolerates a truncated JSON args prefix from streaming, distinguishes preparing/running/stopped/error, and flattens structured result blocks.
Inline skill chip whose activation comes from its own Session-bound injected openSkill action.
Nine-key skill dictionary for the row states and the user-only menu marker.
Skill UserText matcher: reads the skillNames fact lazily and only once a slash-token candidate exists, requires whitespace boundaries, and never strips attached punctuation.
Six-line ambient CSS-module typing.
Nine-line empty Host half of the skill plugin.

594-line spec driving the captured source directly: exact RPC payload, single-flight cache, one-key vs all-keys invalidation, lexicon settlement, plain-text pick, and cancellation of pending previews under reset/preset/plugin/dispose.
CSS contract spec reading the stylesheet from disk and asserting the exact shared font-axis declaration strings.
Tool-row spec: preparation, compact summary, keyboard operation, running/error/stopped states, structured result blocks, and the four argument fallbacks.
Matcher spec pinning the forward-only call offsets, node identity across a Facts change, frozen inputs, and the whitespace-boundary rule.
Thirteen project references for ui-skill including core/session and ui-tool.
Three-line bundler config calling the shared clientBundle helper.
Manifest for the web boot kernel; exports ./injections separately for the page owner, and pins zod and @tanstack/react-virtual to exact versions as the shared-module contract.
Bilingual pairing hash record for the web package README (17 sections including the source-map table).
Boot kernel reference: two-stage boot, the full-roster activation audit, the framework-free boot page, the shared module table that does not negotiate versions, and the no-partial-UI limitation.
Chinese mirror of the boot kernel reference with the same nine-row source-map table.
Page-side interpreter for the Host injection table: rows execute in strict table order, script-preload is a documented no-op, and an unknown row kind throws via assertNever.

Shell stylesheet: darwin app-region rules built on the data-window-drag mark, one :is() interactive subtraction, body > :not(#root) overlay subtraction, and text-autospace rules that spare literal payloads.
Client composition and the aggregated activation audit that names every non-active entry with its reason (import failed, pending on a service, or other state).
Boot page styles with their own fallback colour tokens, a conic-gradient progress arc driven by the --dsh-boot-arc custom property, and a dark-theme override.
Framework-free boot page: plain DOM so a bundle or plugin failure stays visible, the spinner node reused across renders to preserve its animation phase, and a monotonic arc as entries activate.

AppWebEntry: the boot-readiness deferred gate, module system creation with transport precedence, immediate-tier prefetch that swallows errors, the drag-recall watcher installed before first mount, then bootClient plus mountClient.
Six-line ambient CSS-module typing for the shell.
Twelve-line library entry exporting AppWebEntry, getStaticModules, the platform tables and applyIndexInjections.
Mirrors cordis's FiberState const enum as a value object with a Record<FiberState, LoaderEntryState> label table, inlining-safe for esbuild pipelines.
Mounts the UI renderer through a dependency fiber on uiRenderer so replacing the service remounts the application and runs the old disposer first.
PLATFORM_MODULES (11 specifiers) as the implicit external baseline every dynamic bundle resolves against, plus an empty-but-stable PRELOADED_CLIENT_EXTERNALS.
Static module table handed to the loader; the satisfies Record<PlatformModule, unknown> pin makes a drift between the table and the platform list a compile error.

The one window-drag watcher: clear-then-set pulse in a single frame so Electron recollects the app-regions, a two-frame grace for transitions reporting the from-value, MutationObserver plus per-row ResizeObserver, and darwin-only installation.
Executable model of the app-region composition rule (last box in DOM order wins, half-open edges) plus the DRAG_MARK/RECALL_MARK attributes and the INTERACTIVE_SELECTOR constant.
Stylesheet contract spec: asserts no theme import and that the darwin :is() selector list is byte-identical to INTERACTIVE_SELECTOR.
Composition and audit spec over a real module system plus a duck-typed loader double; pins the per-entry state sequence and the exact failure messages.
Boot page spec: skeleton, exact progress-arc angles, failed-entry list, failure report replacing the spinner, spinner node identity, and disposal.

Whole-boot spec: failure rendering versus carrier-owned fatal presentation, prefetch through the injected transport, out-of-order entry creation, and the boot-readiness gate keeping the same boot DOM node.
Mount spec: mount, unmount on tree disposal, and remount when the uiRenderer service is replaced.
446-line drag-watcher spec driven entirely through the scheduleFrame and watchBox seams, with frame-queue ownership so every pulse is decided by the test.
Composition-rule spec (node environment): order direction, edge half-openness, and that INTERACTIVE_SELECTOR is a plain comma list containing no :is(.
Project references for the shell (store, cordis, loader, modules, ui-slots/primitives/dockkit/renderer, host/webserver) with an explicit **/*.legacy.* exclusion.
Bundler config using the shared staticLinked helper and building apply-injections as its own entry for the ./injections export.
